title: The Histaminergic System: A Key Regulator of Pathogenesis and an Emerging Therapeutic Target in Autism Spectrum Disorder.
snippet: Autism spectrum disorder (ASD) is a heterogeneous neurodevelopmental condition defined by core deficits in social communication and restricted, repetitive behaviors.
